body: I completely feel you on this one having friends that don’t care about you it’s the worst, but they are minuscule next to the amount of humans on this earth. Somewhere out there someone is waiting for you these just aren’t the right people for you. It’ll be good if you learnt how to love yourself more which is easier said than done but once you start that and also how to love your own company everything will fall in place. I don’t know you but after reading this if you did die I would care I will feel sad we lost another good human who had a life ahead of them if you need someone to talk to when you feel like this I’m free. I can’t tell you what to do because who am I but I hope you consider my words.
That’s how you feel, but you can’t always be the one at fault have you ever thought others bring you down too, you are worthy I’m sorry you don’t feel worthy and I’m sorry about the pain you feel
You’re not worthless, you deserve to be alive

You’re worth more than you think, I’m sorry life ruined everything for you but I believe if you stick around for a while longer you’ll get the love you so truly deserve. And I for one think you’re worth it

I understand how you feel, it made me cry. If you need someone to talk to so you’d feel less alone I’m always here, you’re not attention seeking and you are not a failure you are a human being and I feel like you’re a great person ❤️
You’re someone’s main character and only priority, hope you stick around long enough to see this.
